वैनतेय m. 1. An epithet of Garuḍa, वैनतेयशमितस्य भोगिनः R.xi.59, Bg.x.30; 2. an epithet of Aruṇa.
वैनयिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Relating to discipline; 2. enforcing proper behaviour.
वैनायिक m. 1. The doctrines of a Buddhistic sect; 2. a follower of that sect.

वैनीतक n. The same as विनीतिक q.v.
